text:
morgan: Five-word epic contest: go! Winner gets the last refrigerated croissant. Drop your five-word saga. I'll start: 'Serverless dragon ate our logs.'

kai: Tiny masterpiece: 'Cache warmed, hearts colder still.'

sam: Microwave PSA: please don't reheat fish. Legit hazard. :nose:

lin: @morgan rule clarification — do hyphenated words count as one? :thinking_face:

morgan: Official rule: hyphens count as one *unless* it's a literal monster. Also croissant remains prize. :croissant: :trophy:

riley: Entry: 'Quantized unicorn debugged my coffee.'

deploy-bot: nightly-tests passed ✅ (not gonna lie, flex).

sam: Also reminder: communal milk labeled 'Lin' is not a suggestion. Please label your dairy. :milk_glass: :label:

kai: oops guilty. I left chili at 4pm — will label now. Sorry everyone. :sweat_smile:

morgan: Quick label template if helpful:
```
LABEL: chili-4pm
OWNER: kai
EXPIRY: 2d
```

lin: beautiful. I voted for 'Cache warmed...' but all of these slap. :clap:

riley: croissant bribe is peak management. :joy:

morgan: Vote poll — react to the original message with :one: :two: :three: :four: for entries in order (mine/kai/riley/sam). I'll tally at 5pm.

sam: also, tiny kudos — @kai fixed the shared drive permissions earlier, super clutch. :raised_hands:

kai: thanks! team effort. Also please, for the love of office etiquette, if you reheat leftovers check for mysterious content first. :grimacing:

riley: last line: 'Elevator music taught me patience.' (ok that's six words, ig) :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:

morgan: Close enough. This thread achieves its mission: laughs + labels + a potential croissant heist. :sneaky:
